title: S.K.Offset IPO Details
intro:
S.K.Offset IPO is a book build issue of ₹29.06 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 23.25 lakh shares of ₹29.06 crore.

S.K.Offset IPO opens for subscription on Sep 23, 2026 and closes on Sep 25, 2026. The allotment for the S.K.Offset IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 28, 2026. S.K.Offset IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 30, 2026.

S.K.Offset IPO is set issue price band at ₹119 to ₹125 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,50,000 (2,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,75,000.

Comfort Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is SMC Global Securities Ltd.

Refer to S.K.Offset IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in February 2007, S. K. Offset Limited is engaged in providing integrated printing and packaging solutions.The Company started its operations with offset printing and has gradually expanded into labelling and packaging solutions. Its printing services include books, textbooks, brochures, catalogues, stationery, pamphlets, magazines, journals and other commercial printing requirements. The Company also undertakes designing, graphics, lithography and publication-related activities.

The Company's product offerings are classified into Printing, Packaging and Labelling. Its packaging portfolio includes mono cartons, master cartons, boxes and other customised packaging products, while its labelling business covers stickers, product labels, barcodes and promotional materials in different sizes, formats and finishes. The Company also provides digital design services for packaging artwork, layout preparation, colour formatting and print-ready files.

The Company has undertaken forward integration across printing, packaging and labelling, enabling customers to source multiple products from a single supplier. It also trades, imports and exports printing and packaging materials such as paper, paperboard, foils and inks. Its integrated operations support product diversification and manufacturing capacity utilisation across different customer requirements.The Company serves customers across multiple industries and operates with an in-house production and operational structure.

As of the date of the Red Herring Prospectus, the Company had approximately 111 employees, comprising skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled personnel across production, administration, sales and marketing, finance, stock management and other functions.
strengths: Integrated printing, packaging and labelling capabilities.

faqs.question: How to apply in S.K.Offset IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in S.K.Offset IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in S.K.Offset IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in S.K.Offset IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' S.K.Offset IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When S.K.Offset IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The S.K.Offset IPO opens on Wed, Sep 23, 2026 and closes on Fri, Sep 25, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of S.K.Offset IPO?
faqs.answer: S.K.Offset IPO lot size is 1000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,50,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for S.K.Offset IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in S.K.Offset IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is S.K.Offset IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for S.K.Offset IPO will be done on Monday, September 28, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 29, 2026 . Check the S.K.Offset IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is S.K.Offset IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The S.K.Offset IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Sep 30, 2026 .
